old: An unsigned GET to the S3 endpoint commoncrawl.s3.amazonaws.com answered 403 on 2026-10-30, while HTTPS on data.commoncrawl.org and the Hugging Face bucket mirror served the same WARC file list with no account.
new: An unsigned GET to the S3 endpoint commoncrawl.s3.amazonaws.com answered 403 on 2026-10-30 and again on 2026-11-03, while HTTPS on data.commoncrawl.org and the Hugging Face bucket mirror served the same WARC file list with no account. Common Crawl documents access through the S3 API from the Amazon cloud as restricted to authenticated AWS users, with unsigned access to s3://commoncrawl/ disabled and an aws --no-sign-request call failing with 403 Forbidden; the Get Started page still shows --no-sign-request commands in a second AWS CLI section.

reason: an unsigned S3 GET is still refused with 403, and Common Crawl documents unsigned s3://commoncrawl/ access as disabled, including from inside AWS
